description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to test prioritization heuristics, including TestPrioritizations, AggregatedHeuristics, and HeuristicInterface, used for managing and aggregating test prioritization scores and heuristics results.

classes.name: TestPrioritizations
classes.description: Manages test prioritization scores, validation, and retrieval of test ranking information.

classes.name: AggregatedHeuristics
classes.description: Aggregates multiple heuristic results to produce a combined test prioritization.

classes.name: HeuristicInterface
classes.description: Interface for heuristic classes, defining required methods and properties.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates internal consistency of test scores and test sets.

methods.name: _traverse_scores
methods.description: Iterates over test scores sorted by score and name.

methods.name: set_test_score
methods.description: Sets the score for a specific test run and updates related test scores.

methods.name: add_test_score
methods.description: Adds a score to relevant test runs, updating existing scores.

methods.name: get_all_tests
methods.description: Returns a list of all test runs in the prioritization.

methods.name: get_top_per_tests
methods.description: Splits tests into top n% and the rest based on scores.

methods.name: get_info_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of test scores, optionally verbose.

methods.name: get_priority_info_for_test
methods.description: Provides prioritization info for a specific test run.

methods.name: get_test_stats
methods.description: Returns detailed statistics for a specific test run.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON-compatible dictionary.

methods.name: from_json
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON dictionary into a TestPrioritizations object.

methods.name: amend_tests
methods.description: Removes or adds tests in the prioritization based on a provided list.

methods.name: add_heuristic_results
methods.description: Adds heuristic results to the aggregate, validating consistency.

methods.name: get_aggregated_priorities
methods.description: Returns combined test prioritization from all heuristics.

methods.name: get_test_stats
methods.description: Provides aggregated statistics for a test, including heuristic info.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the aggregate heuristics to JSON.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the class with a list of all tests.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates internal consistency of heuristic results.
